Hello!

My name is Jane Stephenson and I am a doctoral candidate in Psychology at Stanford University.
I work with Dr. Laura Carstensen in the [Lifespan Development Laboratory](https://lifespan.stanford.edu/).

I study emotional and social changes across the life course, with a focus on how people of different ages form and maintain relationships with each other as well as how such relationships support well-being. In particular, my work has examined age differences in the links between social interactions and emotional experience in daily life as well as how grandparents support their grandchildren's well-being. 

Check out my [research page](/research.qmd) for more details on past and current projects.
